### Goal ###
The non-starter rules stop treating a slow but running idle as cranking, and stop treating a normal cold start as
flooding (T-AUD-23i CONTRADICTED, `reviews/RULING_T-AUD-24o.md`). The no-start speed boundary moves under the
regulator's idle floor, MW-005's running gate moves with it so the two rules still split at one speed, and the
NS-002 coolant gate moves under CARB's normal cold-start band. Done is step 4 printing `24o OK` and the suites at P2.
